result.summary: A Portuguese simplified invoice (Fatura Simplificada FS A/42402, Original) issued by hair salon Maria da Glória Cabeleireiros Lda., Centro Comercial Primavera, Coimbra (NIF 121653897), printed 2020-11-04 11:16. It lists two services — BRUSHING MEDIO (1 × 10,00) and LAVAGEM (1 × 2,20) — both at 23% IVA, for a total of 12,20 EUR, paid in cash (Forma Pag. DINHEIRO). The VAT breakdown shows 2,28 IVA on a 9,92 base, and the document notes it was processed by certified software nº 2648/AT (Sage) and does not constitute a transport document under Decreto-Lei nº 147/2003.

A credit note ("Nota de Crédito") issued by Zara Home – Forum Coimbra (Zara Home Portugal, Artigos e Utilidades para o Lar, S.A., NIF 506648117), dated 10-11-2020 at 17:14, store 1718, credit note no. NS 001718012020/000851. It credits one item, a rug ("Tapete"), at 99.99 EUR (subtotal 81.29 plus 23% VAT of 18.70), settled as an exchange of goods ("Permuta de bens") of 99.99 EUR. The reason given is "Devolução" (return), and it references the original sales document FS 001715012020/014205. The document notes it was processed by a certified program (certificado nº 2742/AT).

A thermal point-of-sale receipt titled 'Fatura Simplificada' from Flying Tiger Copenhagen (Tiger Portugal, SA) at Fórum Coimbra, Portugal, printed 2021-05-06 11:48. It records the sale of one item, a BAG FOLDABEL BLACK W (code 3026325), at €3.00 including 23% VAT (VAT €0.56 on a base of €2.44), paid in full by Multibanco. The slip notes exchanges only with the invoice within 30 days, no returns accepted, and states it was processed by AT-certified software (nº 2648/AT – Sage) and does not constitute a transport document under Decreto-Lei nº 147/2003.
